item.title: Meteorologists record most snow in Copenhagen since 2011
item.description: The Danish Meteorological Institute (DMI) reported 17 centimeters of snow in Copenhagen, marking the second highest recorded snow depth since 2011. The highest was 18.7 centimeters in January 2011. Challenges from the winter weather led Copenhagen to deploy snowplows for the first time in 15 years, with about 160 machines in use. item.title: “Design is embedded in Danish culture”: Designmuseum director Anne-Louise Sommer on how Danish design helps internationals understand Denmark
item.description: Designmuseum director Anne-Louise Sommer discusses heritage, craftsmanship, sustainability, and why international visitors notice Danish design more clearly than locals often do.

item.title: Nordea lays off hundreds of employees
item.description: Nordea has announced a round of layoffs, impacting 271 employees in the bank’s IT department, as confirmed to Ekstra Bladet and Ritzau. Of these, 93 are in Denmark. item.title: Novo shares rise after announcement from US drug chief
item.description: After significant drops, Novo Nordisk’s stock led the Danish C25 index Friday morning with a rise of over five percent. item.title: Spreading of extremist propaganda could cost man his citizenship
item.description: A 30-year-old man’s alleged distribution of right-wing extremist propaganda could cost him his Danish citizenship. Copenhagen’s Prosecutor has charged the man, having received approval from the justice minister. item.title: EU wants TikTok to change addictive design
item.description: The EU Commission has announced that TikTok must change its “addictive design” to avoid large fines from the EU. The Commission believes that the China-owned company violates the EU’s Digital Services Act. A preliminary investigation by the EU administration shows that TikTok has not adequately assessed how the app’s features contribute to addiction and harm […]

item.title: Holding Steady in Unsettled Times: Psychological tools for coping with uncertainty and anxiety as an expat
item.description: Many expats are physically distant from family, long-standing friendships, and familiar support systems. When global events add another layer of unpredictability, it can intensify feelings of loneliness, uncertainty or doubt.
